title: Firefighter hero named as official killed at World of Outlaws dirt track race after emergency vehicles crash - NewsBreak
text:
By Henry Ollis-Brown ,
14 hours ago A FIREFIGHTER hero has been named as the official killed at the World of Outlaws dirt track race.
The firefighter was killed after emergency vehicles crashed during a World of Outlaws race.
World of Outlaws official Billy Hurt poses for a photo Credit: iaff local The World Of Outlaws Sprint Car at Las Vegas Motor Speedway Credit: Getty Billy Hurt has been named as the official killed during the event near Fort Worth, Texas , on Saturday.
Race official Hurt was 65 years old.
He was responding to an accident on an all-terrain vehicle at Kennedale Speedway.
Hurt was riding to the the aid of Marcus Thomas after the driver flipped his car.
It has been widely reported that he was fatally injured after colliding with another emergency response vehicle.
Both emergency responders were ejected from their vehicles in the crash with Hurt dying at the scene.
Safety Official Jerry Myers is recovering from his injuries and in a stable condition.
Saturday’s World of Outlaws event was canceled after the crash.
'YOUR COLOR'
World Racing Group CEO Brian Carter has released a statement following Hurt’s death.
“Beyond his professionalism, Billy exemplified what it meant to be a good person, always putting others before himself,” Carter said. “He dedicated his life to ensuring the safety of every racer.
“And beyond the track, his kindness shone further with every interaction, quickly becoming a friendly face to everyone he met. The entire World Racing Group family is deeply saddened by his loss.”
Hunt served for more than 23 years as a Sprint Car safety official.
He also worked as a Columbia, Missouri , firefighter for over 25 years.
Sprint Car driver Brian Brown has also shared a touching tribute to Hurt.
“Last night at Kennedale Speedway Park was a reminder of just how much the people behind the scenes mean to our sport,” Brown said on X .
“Sending thoughts and prayers to everyone involved, especially the @WorldOfOutlaws officials, along with their families and friends.”
Hurt will be laid to rest in Pisgah Cemetery in Bunceton, Missouri, following his funeral on Monday, March 23.
World of Outlaws is scheduled to return on Friday, March 20, at Lawton Speedway in Oklahoma .
